verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents an official PowerShell module and RESTful APIs for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups, publishes an API 2.0 spec (index.yaml), and maintains a GitHub support repo with API examples. That is a usable official client path, but the evidence never names dedicated, versioned language SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of official multi-language SDKs (e.g. Python/Go/JS), SDK reference docs and install/package details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them.
